items.name: Alignment Reticle
items.depicts: A large circular target of three concentric violet rings bisected by thick dark-indigo vertical and horizontal crosshairs.
items.concept: photolithography reticle and wafer alignment target

items.name: Diffraction Fringe
items.depicts: Concentric dark-indigo and violet circular rings enclosing a pale-lavender central cross, resembling an optical interference pattern.
items.concept: optical diffraction and Airy-disk interference fringes

items.name: Silicon Lattice
items.depicts: Three staggered rows of violet square lattice sites with a single pale-lavender square standing out as a point defect in the middle row.
items.concept: monocrystalline silicon wafer lattice with a point defect

items.name: Dopant Ion
items.depicts: A dark-indigo circular ring enclosing a pale-lavender cross-shaped core, representing an implanted impurity atom.

items.name: Bitwise Mask
items.depicts: A violet square frame containing two offset dark-indigo rectangular apertures on a clear field, depicting a chrome-on-quartz photomask.

items.name: EUV Photon
items.depicts: A bright violet horizontal bar crossing a faint lavender vertical beam, forming a compact 10x10 optical flare.

items.name: Photoresist Trench
items.depicts: Four evenly spaced violet vertical pillars rising from a dark-indigo horizontal substrate band, showing developed photoresist trenches.
items.concept: developed photoresist trenches on a silicon wafer

items.name: Killer Defect
items.depicts: A tiny 5x5-pixel plus-shaped speck—pure white in v0 and grey-armed with a white center in v2—isolated in a 26x22 transparent frame.
items.concept: stray EUV exposure photon or airborne cleanroom particle
